card.text: Explore Siarnaq, a moon of Saturn, through its source-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Siarnaq is a distant prograde moon of Saturn. This approximate triangular shape follows a published light-curve model’s outline, with assumed depth and polar caps. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Convex-model envelope approximation
model.summary: Coarse envelope of the published convex-model views, volume-scaled to a 39 ± 6 km diameter. Projection, depth, polar caps and initial meridian are approximate; this is not the original inversion mesh.
